scope: CVPR2022 paper pre-training architecture with 75% masking example; pinned official implementation corroborates restoration and masked-only MSE. A 4x4 teaching grid depicts 16 image-patch tokens, four visible and twelve removed; class token is not counted. No training, inference evaluation or performance measurement.
typography: Arial-like sans serif; local mechanism labels bold, body/branch annotations clear at seven-inch publication width. Keep exact short labels and token geometry legible. No giant overall header, tiny paragraphs, dense tensor notation or lettering-as-artwork.

blocks.label: Image patches
blocks.representation: A 4x4 grid of sixteen schematic colored image patches, built from flat vector-friendly tile geometry, not a real photo. This is the original unmasked source/target image. Use a simple blue/teal/sand landscape-like arrangement of flat squares, no painterly texture.

blocks.label: Visible-only encoder
blocks.representation: Mask 75% removes twelve of sixteen patches; gather exactly FOUR blue visible patch tokens into a substantial Encoder. No gray mask placeholders/tokens enter it. Exactly four encoded-visible patch glyphs leave it. Patch projection, positions and class-token bookkeeping are internal; token counts refer to IMAGE PATCH TOKENS ONLY. Show the changing token load, not a generic equal-card process.

blocks.label: Restore order
blocks.representation: Learned mask tokens are identical gray vector squares. They join the FOUR encoded blue visible patch tokens ONLY AFTER the Encoder. Restoration indices produce a full 4x4 decoder token grid containing exactly four blue visible latents and twelve gray mask tokens. Source positions are restored; this is not a second random mask and not pixel predictions.

blocks.label: Lightweight decoder
blocks.representation: Visibly smaller/narrower transformer module consuming the FULL restored sequence. Trainable during pre-training; no snowflake/frozen symbol. Decoder/pixel projection yields all patch predictions, not just four or only missing-position logits.

blocks.label: Masked-patch MSE
blocks.representation: Compact support inset. A 4x4 pixel prediction glyph covers ALL positions; compare against original pixel target from the same source image. The same binary mask selects the twelve removed patch positions for MSE. Use a small gold mask-selector key and dashed mask-metadata input. Internal prediction/target→MSE arrows must be legible. Predictions are schematic, not a guaranteed identical reconstruction. No performance/accuracy/cost badges.

relations.display: Original sixteen image patches enter 75% random removal; twelve are discarded and FOUR visible patch tokens remain.
Within the sparse lane only the four gathered visible patches enter Encoder; removed patches and learned mask tokens never do.
Encoder outputs four encoded visible patch representations (patch tokens only).
Only encoded-visible output feeds the post-encoder restoration/decoder-projection point.
Within restoration, twelve copies of the shared learned gray mask token join the four blue visible latents after encoding.
Thin dashed mask-metadata line carries original-position restoration indices to Restore order, not pixel values or mask tokens into Encoder.
The restored full 16-slot sequence (four blue + twelve gray) enters Lightweight decoder.
Lightweight decoder predicts pixel values for ALL sixteen patch positions.
Thin separate target-reference path from original image patches supplies Original target to the small supervision inset; never a target input to Encoder.
Within the supervision inset, all-position Pixel predictions feed MSE, whose selector retains masked positions only.
Within the supervision inset, Original target supplies pixel targets for the selected masked positions.
Thin dashed gold metadata path carries the SAME binary mask to the Masked-patch MSE selector; visible-patch predictions are not scored.

palette.meaning: Original image/target pixels, deterministic masking/restoration and decoder support
Visible patch embeddings and encoded visible patch tokens
Learned missing-position mask tokens; introduced after encoder
All-position pixel predictions; no correctness guarantee
Masked-position selector and its self-supervision objective

forbidden: Mask tokens or masked patches entering the encoder
A full sixteen-patch encoder token load in the 75% example
Twelve independently different learned mask vectors instead of shared token copies
Class token counted as one of sixteen image patches
Loss over visible patches or all patches instead of masked positions
Decoder output only visible tokens or a subset of pixel predictions
Frozen/snowflake encoder or decoder during pre-training
Target branch fed into encoder or decoder as observed content
New benchmark numbers, exact speedup promises, guaranteed reconstruction quality or training execution
A downstream inference decoder/recognition branch in this pre-training scope
Third-party photographic assets, decorative 3D, gradients, shadows or equal numbered cards
